Logical access: only authorised people reach financially relevant systems and data
Change management: changes to in-scope systems are authorised, tested and approved
Computer operations: processing is scheduled, monitored and failures are resolved
Backup and recovery: data is backed up and can be restored
Physical security: physical access to in-scope systems is restricted
New systems: new applications are implemented and tested before use
Client setup: new clients and their standing data are set up completely and accurately
Transaction input: transactions are authorised and recorded completely, accurately and on time
Transaction processing: transactions are processed completely and accurately
Output and reporting: reports to clients are complete, accurate and go to the right people
Reconciliations: balances and records are reconciled and differences resolved
Subservice organisations: their controls are monitored
